newsitem.title: UK: S&P cuts Puerto Rico Electric bonds to BBB plus.
newsitem.headline: S&P cuts Puerto Rico Electric bonds to BBB plus.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Tuesday it had lowered its rating on Puerto Rico Electric Power Authority's (PREPA) $1.8 billion power revenue bonds to BBB plus from A minus and revised the outlook to stable from negative.
-- The financial and rate implications of PREPA's large $1.6 billion capital programme, prompted by a lack of meaningful supply additions and consistently strong load growth;
-- The significant task of adding almost 1,600 MW of additional capacity, which represents over 38 percent of current supplies, over the next four years; and
-- Increased debt burden, customer rates and annual expenses resulting from PREPA's ambitious, yet much needed, capital additions.
It said the rating continued to incorporate the following factors:
-- A 98 percent dependence on oil for generation without commensurate hedging protection,
-- Adequate financial margins with a lack of considerable flexibility, and
-- The absence of competitive forces which pressure mainland U.S. electric utilities.
